description: This header defines the API for managing dynamic, NULL-terminated arrays of strings (`strvec`). It includes struct definitions, macros for initialization, and prototypes for functions that manipulate string vectors, such as pushing, inserting, removing, splitting, and clearing strings within the vector.

methods.name: strvec_init
methods.description: Initializes a strvec structure, setting its internal array pointer to a predefined empty array.

methods.name: strvec_push
methods.description: Duplicates a given string and adds it to the end of the string vector.

methods.name: strvec_push_nodup
methods.description: Adds an already allocated string to the string vector, taking ownership of the memory.

methods.name: strvec_pushf
methods.description: Formats a string with printf-like syntax and appends it to the string vector.

methods.name: strvec_pushl
methods.description: Pushes a variadic list of strings onto the string vector, ending with NULL.

methods.name: strvec_pushv
methods.description: Appends an array of strings to the string vector.

methods.name: strvec_splice
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the vector with a new list of strings, or inserts/deletes based on parameters.

methods.name: strvec_replace
methods.description: Replaces the string at a specified index with a new string.

methods.name: strvec_remove
methods.description: Removes a string at a specified index and shifts subsequent elements to fill the gap.

methods.name: strvec_pop
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: strvec_split
methods.description: Splits an input string into tokens based on whitespace and appends them to the vector.

methods.name: strvec_clear
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the vector and resets it.

methods.name: strvec_detach
methods.description: Detaches the internal array from the vector, returning the raw pointer for external management.
